extracted.name: Dumpling Dipping Sauce
extracted.description: This dipping sauce with two kinds of soy sauce, chili oil, garlic, and ginger is great for dipping Asian-style finger foods like egg rolls and pot stickers.
ingredient_lines: 0.25 teaspoon minced green onion, or to taste
instruction_lines: Whisk light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, red wine vinegar, chili oil, ginger, sugar, garlic, and green onion together in a bowl; pour into a sealable container, seal, and refrigerate 1 hour.
